name: harness-protocol
description: Orchestrator → Developer → Verifier → Auditor harness for multi-sprint / multi-file work. Generator never self-evaluates. >9/10 per-criterion threshold. Auditor scores against typed Vn assertions from a Validation Contract authored before any code. Hard dependency on obra/superpowers. Project-agnostic.
